dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hello! Are you a university student?
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ! ər juː ə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈstuːdənt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I am. Are you a student, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈæm. ər juː ə ˈstuːdənt, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, I'm not. I'm the teacher, Mr. Brown.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪm ˈnɑːt. aɪm ðə ˈtiːtʃər, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh! My friend Emma is your student!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ! maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈɛmə ɪz jʊr ˈstuːdənt!
